key.description: Destination key; default from with reflected parameters flipped about their default and sided parameters (ParamEyeLOpen) swapped for their opposite where the destination binds it or neither, missing destination axes at default.

channels.description: What to carry over: the reflected geometry and channel values as they are at from; default geometry only.

density.description: Texture density heatmap: tint each layer by its texture pixels per canvas unit - blue at 1/4 or less, green at 1, orange at 4 or more - and list them in texelDensity

parameters.description: Cubism parameter ID to value, for example {ParamAngleX: 10.0}. Omitted parameters render at their defaults, not at the authored pose; read workspace_inspect scope=preview and pass its values to start from it. Rendering never changes the authored pose.

include_layer_ids.description: Exact layer IDs to composite. Omit to follow the active canvas's local visibility, so layers the user hid, layers under a hidden deformer and layers outside a solo are missing; pass IDs for a result independent of the canvas. [] renders no model layers.

grid.description: Draw grid lines every so many canvas units, labelled with canvas coordinates along the top and left; a step too fine for the view is coarsened (x2, x5, x10...) and gridStep says the step drawn

outline_material_ids.description: Material items with a place on this canvas (drawings from material_draw, crops) whose opaque edge is traced over the view where they sit, each in its own colour with its id; compares a drawing's shape with the reference without placing it

layer_id.description: Stable layer ID returned by project_list_layers

object_scale.description: Fraction of the fitted view occupied by the focused layer; values below 1 show surroundings

aspect_ratio.description: Output frame width divided by height; the layer is fitted without stretching
